name: viaduct-person-start
viaduct-person-start-at
js: (() => { const a = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY, e = a.controllerManager.getActiveEntity(), p = e.position; return { mode: a.controllerManager.activeMode, x: +p.x.toFixed(1), y: +p.y.toFixed(2), z: +p.z.toFixed(1), water: !!C.waterAt(p.x, p.z), deck: C.deckStoodOn ? !!C.deckStoodOn(p.x, p.z, p.y, 0.6) : null, bridgeSidewalk: !!(C.bridgeSidewalkAt && C.bridgeSidewalkAt(p.x, p.z)), curbIsland: !!C.blockAt(p.x, p.z) }; })()
